en.name: Ssamjang
en.summary: Ssamjang is doenjang and gochujang blended with sesame oil, garlic, onion and sugar — the sauce that goes into a lettuce wrap. Unopened tubs keep about 12–18 months in the cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate and use within about 3–6 months.
en.pantry: Unopened commercial tubs keep to the printed date in a cool dark cupboard, about 12–18 months from purchase. Ssamjang is sweeter, wetter and softer than either of its parent pastes, which is why it does not keep as long as a plain doenjang; salt and low water activity are doing less of the work here. Keep tubs away from the hob and out of the sun, and do not store one whose seal has been broken.
en.fridge: Refrigerate after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 3–6 months. That figure starts from the miso line and is cut roughly in half, because ssamjang carries added sugar, sesame oil and fresh aromatics that miso does not — the halving is an editorial judgement rather than a published number. Press the surface flat, keep the lid tight, and use a clean dry spoon. Homemade ssamjang, mixed with raw garlic and spring onion and never heat-treated, is a much shorter proposition: make what you will eat over a week or two and keep it cold.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for ssamjang and it is not worth freezing. The salt and sugar keep it from freezing hard, the sesame oil separates, and the fresh garlic and onion in it lose their bite. Since the fridge already gives an opened tub months, the practical move is to buy the tub size that matches how often you grill. A homemade batch is better made small than frozen.
spoilage: Fuzzy or coloured mould on the surface or around the rim
A rotten, yeasty or alcoholic smell rather than a deep savoury-sweet one
A swollen tub, or gas escaping when the lid comes off
The paste gone watery and separated, or dried to a dark crust
tips: Press the surface flat after each use so no air pockets sit in the paste.
Use a clean dry spoon — never one that has been at the table.
Write the opening date on the tub.
Make homemade ssamjang in small batches; raw garlic and spring onion shorten it sharply.

faq.q: How long does ssamjang last once opened?
faq.a: About 3–6 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below. That is adapted from miso and shortened, because ssamjang has added sugar, oil and fresh aromatics.

faq.q: How long does an unopened tub keep?
faq.a: About 12–18 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, to the printed date.

faq.q: How long does homemade ssamjang keep?
faq.a: Much less. It contains raw garlic and spring onion, so make only what you will eat over a week or two and keep it refrigerated.
There is no timeline and it is not worth doing — the oil separates and the fresh aromatics lose their bite.

zh.name: 韓式包飯醬
zh.summary: 包飯醬是把大醬和辣椒醬混合，再加芝麻油、蒜、洋蔥和糖調成的醬，就是生菜包肉時抹的那一味。未開封的盒裝放櫥櫃大約 12～18 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的市售盒裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 12～18 個月。包飯醬比它的兩個「母體」醬更甜、更濕、也更軟，所以不像純大醬那麼耐放；鹽和低水活性在這裡能做的事比較少。請遠離爐火、避免日曬，封口已經破掉的就不要再存放。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。這個數字是從味噌的資料出發、再約略砍半，因為包飯醬多了味噌沒有的糖、芝麻油和新鮮辛香料——而「砍半」是編輯判斷，不是已發表的數字。請把表面壓平、蓋子蓋緊，並使用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。自製包飯醬拌了生蒜和蔥、又完全沒有加熱處理，時間短得多：做一兩週吃得完的量，並全程冷藏。
zh.freezer: 包飯醬沒有冷凍期限，也不值得冷凍。鹽和糖讓它凍不硬，芝麻油會分離，裡面的生蒜和洋蔥也會失去衝勁。既然冷藏已經給了開封後好幾個月，實際的做法是依你烤肉的頻率選盒子大小。自製的與其冷凍，不如一次少做一點。
spoilage: 醬面或盒緣長出毛狀或有顏色的霉
聞起來是腐敗味、酵母味或酒味，而不是深沉的鹹甜醬香
盒子膨脹，或開蓋時有氣體跑出
醬出水分離，或乾成深色硬殼
tips: 每次取完把表面壓平，不要讓醬裡留下空氣孔隙。
用乾淨乾燥的湯匙——絕對不要用上過桌的那支。
自製請少量製作；生蒜和蔥會大幅縮短保存期。

faq.q: 包飯醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 3～6 個月。這是從味噌的資料調整並縮短而來，因為包飯醬多了糖、油和新鮮辛香料。

faq.q: 未開封的包飯醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12～18 個月，以標示日期為準。

faq.q: 自製包飯醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 短很多。它含生蒜和蔥，請只做一兩週吃得完的量，並全程冷藏。
沒有對應期限，也不值得——油會分離，新鮮辛香料也會失去衝勁。
